book.subject: math
book.lesson_titles_note: A book of its own, ingested from its PDF by the book-record pipeline (Tamer, 2026-10-17: treated as a separate book, unrelated to any live course). Its course, course:prep3-parallel-math-en (app/src/lib/courses.ts), is hidden until an operator makes it live. Its lesson slugs carry the pp3 prefixes (pp3u1-1, …), so none of its ids can meet another course's. Lesson titles, page offsets and units come from its own S0 lesson map, approved at G0.

widgets.stem: If $(a - 2, b + 1) = (2, -3)$, find $a$ and $b$, then plot the point $(a, b)$.
widgets.instrument: Spec example {"target":[3,2]} — a coordinate grid (−5..5); the student taps one lattice point. Target coordinates must be whole numbers in −5..5.

reading_fields.target: [x, y], the point the question asks for

diagnostics.predicate_meaning: Plotted (y, x) — the pair read in the wrong order
diagnostics.misconception_label: Treats an ordered pair like an unordered set
diagnostics.misconception_description: The student thinks (a, b) is the same as (b, a), or the same as {a, b}, so they match components in the wrong positions.
